title: Find female patients who had at least one laboratory test in 1981 with elev
question: Find female patients who had at least one laboratory test in 1981 with elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH > 500) and at least one (possibly different) test in 1981 with high total cholesterol (T-CHO ≥ 250). For these patients, compute the percentage change in their total cholesterol from November to December 1981.
